deepdive.netdebt: Negative cash flow from ops due to 6-month collection cycle

profile.entities: Justo Realfintech Limited; Chesterton India (joint venture)
profile.subseg: Residential Sales; Commercial Sales; DSA Home Loan Facilitation; Advisory & Capital Markets
profile.themes: AI/ML-driven customer targeting; Asset-light mandate model; Market expansion to Bangalore/Hyderabad/Ahmedabad; Tech platform integration (Justo Verse/Works/Pulse)

bull_bear.body: IPO proceeds used to fund tech upgrades and Chesterton JV; no dividends paid; focus on reinvestment in AI, market expansion, and ESOPs; no debt-funded acquisitions planned.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Regulatory delays in environmental/CC approvals; high employee attrition at junior levels; over-reliance on Pune/Mumbai (73%/23%); delayed receivables (180-day DSO); Chesterton JV execution risk; competition from Anarock/Xanadu.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, data-driven, and execution-focused; CEO emphasizes professional governance, tech superiority, and repeat developer relationships; acknowledges past disruption but frames FY26 as inflection point with clear roadmap; tone is bullish on scalability and AI potential.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Justo’s 94% repeat developer rate is a hidden moat — developers outsource entire sales ops to them, creating sticky, high-margin relationships; the 180-day DSO is not a credit risk but a structural delay from registration/home loan cycles; Chesterton JV is not just branding — it’s a re-entry of a 220-year-old global firm with 227 offices, giving Justo instant global credibility and JV deal flow.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Pune: 73% revenue (avg. ticket ₹80L-1Cr); Mumbai: 23% revenue (avg. ticket ₹1.2-1.3Cr); Commercial: 6-7 months old, low contribution; Advisory: ₹5-6Cr FY25, to be replaced by Chesterton JV; New markets (Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad) to contribute from FY26.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Developers struggle with fixed overheads and stalled approvals | Justo Realfintech Limited | beneficiary | High | Justo converts fixed developer costs to variable, mitigates approval delays by only taking RERA-approved projects, and boosts sales velocity via tech-enabled mandates. |
| Home loan disbursement delays hurt developer cash flow | Justo Realfintech Limited | beneficiary | High | Justo’s DSA arm (₹800Cr expected this year) captures loan-related revenue and accelerates collections, strengthening developer loyalty. |
| PropTech firms lack integrated sales + CRM + HR platforms | Justo Realfintech Limited | beneficiary | High | Justo’s proprietary stack (Verse/Works/Pulse) is a defensible moat — no competitor has this full-stack integration. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin ~25% (stable); 75% of costs are employee-related (salaries, incentives); broker payouts account for 2.5-3% of GMV; fixed overheads high due to 500+ employees; cost leverage expected as revenue scales and AI reduces lead acquisition cost.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue growth: 30-40% YoY to ₹125Cr+ in FY26; Margin: Sustain 25% EBITDA; Order inflow: ₹5,000Cr FY26 (₹3,500Cr existing + ₹1,500Cr new); Capex/Commissioning: ₹150-200Cr for tech AI/ML upgrades and Chesterton JV setup, primarily FY26.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: 44 active mandates worth ₹4,000-5,000Cr; total inventory pipeline at ₹7,929Cr (incl. ₹3,000Cr expected in Q4); 50%+ execution expected in FY26.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Entry into Bangalore (Q1FY26), Ahmedabad (Q2FY26), Hyderabad (Q4FY26); Chesterton JV for capital markets/JV/JDA advisory; New verticals in villas and plotting; AI/ML customer targeting to reduce CAC by 30-40%; potential ESOP rollout for retention.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Justo has rebounded from FY24 disruption caused by promoter exit and stalled approvals, now leveraging a 94% repeat developer base and new tech platforms to drive 30-40% revenue growth; the upcoming entry into three new cities and Chesterton JV unlocks a $1.5B+ addressable market beyond its current 1% penetration in Pune/Mumbai.
